news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.25 (down from ₹13.85 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹27.2b (up 36% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹788.6m (down 54% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.9% (down from 8.6% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 65%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 8% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 4% per year.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 16%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹26.1b to ₹24.7b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹20.20 per share to ₹16.93 per share. Net income forecast to grow 220% next year vs 48% growth forecast for Real Estate industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹793 to ₹777. Share price rose 3.2% to ₹507 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.27 (vs ₹1.20 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.27 (down from ₹1.20 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.94b (down 37% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹33.8m (down 78% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.1% (down from 3.2% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 25% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 24% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 6% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Keystone Realtors Limited Appoints Mr. Pritam Chivukula as Senior Management Personnel, Designated as Project CEO - Commercial, Effective January 19, 2026
news.body: Keystone Realtors Limited has appointed Mr. Pritam Chivukula as Senior Management Personnel, designated as Project CEO - Commercial, effective January 19, 2026. Mr. Pritam Chivukula has done PGDM (MBA) from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies. He brings with him over 27 years of extensive experience in across real estate development, banking, and real estate private equity. Since 2010, he has been the Co-Founder of Tridhaatu Realty & Infra Pvt. Ltd., a premium, consumer-centric real estate development company in Mumbai. Over the past 16 years, he has led the organisation through sustained growth and innovation, embedding a professional, systems & process-driven culture with a focus on consistent execution and value creation.
